collection.title: Mercedes-Benz CLC 2008 to 2010 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Mercedes-Benz CLC Coupe 2008 to 2010 (203) model which requires a 22" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side. This model uses the Slider wiper arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
